# FabricStageInfo (Fabric bookkeeping)

A [Fabric](glossary.md#fabric) bookkeeping [prim](glossary.md#prim) that populations with RENDERING carry. It has no physics: the parser reads no column of it. It is a component only so the [compiled stage cache](glossary.md#compiled-stage-cache) does not bypass a Stage that contains it.

- **Type chain:** 
- **Applicable APIs:** none
- **Transform columns:** none, not [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## What USD population writes

Written by the Fabric backend of a full-domain population, not by physics population. No [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema declares the type.

## Notes

- No USD schema registers this type, so the type chain is empty and no API schema applies to it.
